newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Sporitelna says 9 month net rises.
newsitem.headline: Czech Sporitelna says 9 month net rises.

text.p: The largest Czech savings bank, Ceska Sporitelna a.s., said on Monday that its nine-month net profit rose to 1.608 billion crowns from 1.193 billion crowns reported for the first three quarters last year.
In a written statement, Sporitelna said the "economic" situation of the bank was "in line" with its expectations.
A full, formal balance sheet was not released.
It said its reserves and provisions for doubtful debt stood at 24 billion crowns at the end of September, but the bank did not give a comparative figure.
Sporitelna ploughed virtually all of its 1995 gross profit of just over nine billion crowns into reserves, raising total reserves to just over 23 billion crowns at the end of last year.
It said its balance sheet total stood at 357.6 billion crowns at the end of September, up from 341.8 billion crowns reported at the end of nine months last year.
